cases.name: min-signers-met
cases.pins: MinSigners is >= on the authenticated-signer count

cases.name: min-signers-unmet
cases.pins: one signer does not meet a floor of two

cases.name: min-signers-zero-floor
cases.pins: MinSigners(0) is vacuously true even with zero signers

cases.name: min-signers-non-contract
cases.pins: MinSigners is context-independent: definite under a non-contract context

cases.name: fn-in-hit
cases.pins: invoked function inside the allowlist

cases.name: fn-in-miss
cases.pins: invoked function outside the allowlist

cases.name: fn-in-empty-is-false
cases.pins: an empty allowlist is vacuously False (definite), not Unknown

cases.name: fn-in-non-contract
cases.pins: context leaf fails closed to Unknown outside a contract call

cases.name: arg-addr-eq-hit
cases.pins: address equality on a matching argument

cases.name: arg-addr-eq-miss
cases.pins: address equality on a differing argument

cases.name: arg-addr-eq-wrong-type
cases.pins: decode failure (u32 argument read as address) is Unknown, never False

cases.name: arg-addr-eq-missing-index
cases.pins: missing argument index is a decode failure

cases.name: arg-addr-is-self-hit
cases.pins: argument is the protected account

cases.name: arg-addr-is-self-miss
cases.pins: argument is some other address

cases.name: arg-sym-eq-hit
cases.pins: symbol equality hit

cases.name: arg-sym-eq-miss
cases.pins: symbol equality miss

cases.name: arg-sym-eq-wrong-type
cases.pins: string argument read as symbol is a decode failure

cases.name: arg-str-in-hit
cases.pins: string set membership hit

cases.name: arg-str-in-miss
cases.pins: string set membership miss

cases.name: arg-str-in-overlong-arg
cases.pins: argument longer than MAX_STR_ARG_LEN fails closed even if the set matches textually

cases.name: arg-str-in-overlong-candidate-skipped
cases.pins: an over-long *candidate* is skipped, not fatal — a later match still hits

cases.name: arg-str-in-only-overlong-candidates
cases.pins: a set of only over-long candidates simply never matches: definite False

cases.name: arg-str-in-256-boundary
cases.pins: exactly MAX_STR_ARG_LEN (256) bytes is still comparable

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-hit
cases.pins: prefix hit

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-exact-equal
cases.pins: a prefix equal to the whole argument matches (pn == sn)

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-longer-than-arg
cases.pins: a prefix longer than the argument is a definite miss, not Unknown

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-miss
cases.pins: prefix miss

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-empty-prefix
cases.pins: the empty prefix matches any decodable string argument

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-overlong-arg
cases.pins: over-long argument fails closed under prefix too

cases.name: arg-str-prefix-overlong-prefix
cases.pins: an over-long *prefix* constant also fails closed (both sides are bounded)

cases.name: arg-bytes-eq-hit
cases.pins: bytes equality hit

cases.name: arg-bytes-eq-miss
cases.pins: bytes equality miss

cases.name: arg-bytes-eq-wrong-type
cases.pins: u32 argument read as bytes is a decode failure

cases.name: arg-i128-eq-hit
cases.pins: i128 equality hit (negative value)

cases.name: arg-i128-eq-miss
cases.pins: i128 equality miss

cases.name: arg-i128-eq-wrong-type
cases.pins: u32 argument is NOT implicitly widened to i128 — strict decode, Unknown

cases.name: arg-u32-eq-hit
cases.pins: u32 equality hit

cases.name: arg-u32-eq-miss
cases.pins: u32 equality miss

cases.name: arg-u32-eq-wrong-type
cases.pins: i128 argument read as u32 is a decode failure

cases.name: arg-u32-eq-void-arg
cases.pins: an undecodable (void) argument is a decode failure

cases.name: arg-count-exact
cases.pins: ArgCount is exact equality on the argument count

cases.name: arg-count-miss
cases.pins: ArgCount misses on any other count

cases.name: arg-count-non-contract
cases.pins: ArgCount inspects the context: Unknown outside a contract call

cases.name: ledger-before-true
cases.pins: strictly-below window is open below the bound

cases.name: ledger-before-boundary-false
cases.pins: LedgerBefore is strict: closed exactly at the bound

cases.name: ledger-at-or-after-boundary-true
cases.pins: LedgerAtOrAfter is inclusive at the bound

cases.name: ledger-at-or-after-false
cases.pins: LedgerAtOrAfter below the bound is False

cases.name: ledger-non-contract
cases.pins: ledger leaves read the env, not the context: definite under non-contract

cases.name: all-true
cases.pins: All folds True over definite-true leaves

cases.name: all-false-wins
cases.pins: All with one False is False

cases.name: all-unknown-poisons-true
cases.pins: All(Unknown, True) is Unknown — a decode failure can never help authorize

cases.name: all-false-beats-unknown
cases.pins: All(Unknown, False) is False — min under False < Unknown < True

cases.name: any-true-beats-unknown
cases.pins: Any(Unknown, True) is True — max under the same order

cases.name: any-all-false
cases.pins: Any over definite-false leaves is False

cases.name: any-unknown-beats-false
cases.pins: Any(Unknown, False) is Unknown — an undecodable branch cannot be assumed False

cases.name: not-true
cases.pins: Not(True) is False

cases.name: not-false
cases.pins: Not(False) is True

cases.name: not-unknown-stays-unknown
cases.pins: THE fail-open trap: a decode failure under Not must deny, not satisfy the guardrail

cases.name: double-not
cases.pins: Not is an involution on definite verdicts

cases.name: ci-publish-shape-allows
cases.pins: the motivating program: MinSigners + FnIn + ArgAddrIsSelf under All

cases.name: ci-publish-shape-denies-zero-signers
cases.pins: the same program fails closed with zero authenticated signers (INV-1)

cases.name: empty-program
cases.pins: no ops: rejected at install; eval yields no root verdict

cases.name: underflow-not
cases.pins: Not with an empty stack underflows

cases.name: underflow-all
cases.pins: All(2) over a single pushed verdict underflows

cases.name: zero-arity-all
cases.pins: All(0) has no identity element on purpose — rejected, and eval fails closed

cases.name: zero-arity-any
cases.pins: Any(0) likewise

cases.name: multi-result
cases.pins: two verdicts left on the stack is not a program

cases.name: partial-consume-multi-result
cases.pins: a fold that consumes only part of the stack still ends multi-result

cases.name: wrong-version-eval-is-version-blind
cases.pins: validate rejects version 2; eval itself never reads the version field

cases.name: depth-at-cap-ok
cases.pins: a simulated depth of exactly MAX_STACK_DEPTH validates and evaluates

cases.name: depth-overflow
cases.pins: MAX_STACK_DEPTH + 1 unfolded leaves overflow the verdict stack

cases.name: program-too-large
cases.pins: MAX_PROGRAM_LEN + 1 ops are rejected at install
